description.text:
The only English cards from the Japanese VS expansion, which Wizards of the Coast never released in English. In Japan, the Tyranitar Half Deck of Owner's Pokémon came out on 7 July 2001 for the fourth Pokémon movie. An altered version was handed to the players of the 2001 Tropical Mega Battle in Hawaii on 26 August 2001, some of them in English, with Tropical Breeze, a card made for the tournament, in place of Rocket's Tyranitar. Media Factory, which made the Japanese cards, printed them instead of Wizards, so they keep the Japanese layout and fonts.

The deck holds Owner's Pokémon such as Clair's Mantine, Bruno's Hitmonchan and Morty's Hypno, with Tropical Breeze, Energy Ark, Super Scoop Up, Switch, Potion and the six basic Energy types. The English Clair's Mantine was printed with a Psychic resistance instead of Fighting, which caused first-round games to be replayed. The deck was given out again at the 2002 World Championships with the card corrected, so this set holds both versions of it.
